description:
[Trading Data API] Free, no signup required. Ethereum gas oracle (safe/propose/fast gas prices + base fee, in gwei), via Etherscan.

**Example:** `/v1/gas`

Use when you need current Ethereum gas prices (safe, standard, fast) and the base fee before sending a transaction. Not for other chains.

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.
name: gas
